exposure: maternal milk administration during neonatal hospital stay
Admission to Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU)
outcome: Factors associated with breastfeeding establishment and maintenance
cohort: Infants/toddlers previously admitted to the NICU (n=279)
finding: Despite breastfeeding being a priority in the NICU, exclusive breastfeeding rates at 6 months were low and prematurity was identified as an independent risk factor for shorter breastfeeding duration.
gest_age: Data on gestational age was collected but specific details not provided.
